domain_restrictions: a is defined as floor(n * t), hence a is an integer
a divided by n is defined (requires n not equal to 0, guaranteed by n > 1)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n with n > 1 and all real numbers t with 0 <= t and t < 1, let a be the floor of n times t. Then E_n(t) is less than or equal to E_n(a divided by n).

variables.name: n
variables.role: outer universally quantified parameter with constraint n > 1

variables.name: t
variables.role: universally quantified input with constraint 0 <= t < 1

variables.name: a
variables.role: auxiliary value defined by a = floor(n * t); depends on n and t

witness_dependencies: a depends on both n and t via a = floor(n * t)

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t with 0 <= t < 1, if a = floor(n*t), then E_n(t) <= E_n(a/n).
